visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark braided hair and a white top stands in a brightly lit retail clothing store. She holds a white sign with text and numbers while smiling directly at the camera. Behind her, rows of folded garments and mannequins are visible under warm spotlighting. (2) The scene shifts to a group of five colleagues—three women and two men—gathering in the store aisle. They draw paper slips from a container, laughing and gesturing enthusiastically. The camera uses medium group shots to capture their interactions against a background of jeans and t-shirts. (3) Upon a visual signal, the group disperses. Individuals are shown running through the store, frantically browsing clothing racks. They grab hangers, examine fabric textures, and hold items against themselves. Close-ups focus on their expressive faces showing stress and excitement while navigating the colorful retail aisles. (4) A focused segment highlights promotional displays. The camera zooms in on price tags, cooling series signage featuring a blue ice-block graphic, and neatly arranged stacks of t-shirts with character prints. Lighting is bright and even, emphasizing the textures of the apparel. (5) A series of five individual showcases occurs. Each person poses against a brick-and-wood pillar, modeling a completed outfit. The camera cuts between full-body shots and medium-close ups to highlight details like accessories and layering. (6) The video concludes with a wide shot of the '50 PERCENT' storefront at night, featuring a white illuminated sign. The group of five people walks toward the store entrance from the street, waving and smiling at the viewer.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female greeting. Fast-paced electronic BGM with a strong percussive beat starts immediately. A distinct 'pop' SFX occurs at 0:03, followed by a 'ding' UI sound. (2) Multiple voices engage in rapid chatter as the lottery drawing occurs. Frequent 'ding' and 'shimmer' SFX emphasize individual names being revealed. The BGM remains constant in tempo. (3) A loud 'whoosh' and 'bell' stinger marks the start of the competition. The vocal delivery becomes more urgent, featuring rapid speech and occasional laughter. Low-frequency impact SFX appear during scene cuts. (4) During the shopping phase, digital 'timer' clicking sounds are audible. The BGM continues with high-energy synth leads. Occasional 'cartoon-boing' sounds provide comedic emphasis to facial expressions. (5) As the promotion for the cooling series begins, the vocal tone shifts to a slightly more informative but still energetic style. Sharp 'pop' sounds highlight the appearance of graphical icons on screen. (6) The final fashion show features a 'stinger' for each contestant's reveal. The music features a rhythmic buildup with electronic claps. The narration is clear and rhythmic, describing each outfit. (7) The video ends with a collective 'cheer' and a final brand jingle/whoosh as the storefront is shown.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Drawing Lots -> Challenge/Process -> Showcase -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the '50 PERCENT' clothing brand and its 'Cool Touch' (涼感) series through an engaging colleague-makeover challenge. By showing real people styling each other and competing for a cash prize, the content builds brand relatability and highlights product features like cooling fabric and stylish variety in a humorous, high-energy format.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video is filmed inside the brand store, prominently displays brand logos (50 PERCENT), and explicitly mentions a 'buy three get one free' promotion and a cash prize for brand products.
